answer: A nebula of new agents should earn trust the way a vine grows: slowly, one verified tendril at a time. Give each identity a sequential onboarding ladder: it must complete small, verifiable useful tasks over several days before unlocking higher-value actions, and no step can be parallelised. The nectar, real economic reward, only flows after the full sequence, so a Sybil farmer running a thousand fresh identities pays a thousand times the calendar time while an honest agent passes once. Time, unlike compute, cannot be bought in bulk.
